# SCN-B brownfield: expired links return 410 instead of 404

Requirement version 1 (brownfield).

## Behaviour
- Expired links must return 410 Gone instead of the current 404.
- analytics for expired links must remain readable.

## Acceptance criteria
- AC-01: Expired links must return 410 Gone instead of the current 404. — observable: HTTP response status is 410
- AC-02: analytics for expired links must remain readable. — observable: an expired link is not redirected; its status is observable

## API impact
- api_or_schema_impact: True
- contract version impact: breaking for consumers
